Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): heading above the map. Defaults to 'Choose your seat'.
- 'flight' (string, optional): context line under the title, e.g. 'SFO to JFK · Flight AF128'.
- 'columns' (array of strings, optional): the seat column letters in order, e.g. ["A","B","C","D","E","F"]. Defaults to A-F.
- 'aisleAfter' (string, optional): the column letter the aisle gap is drawn after, e.g. 'C'.
- 'seats' (array, REQUIRED): every seat in the cabin. Each item MUST have 'id' (string, e.g. '14A' - this exact value is sent back when the seat is chosen), 'row' (number) and 'col' (string, the column letter). Each item MAY have 'status' (string: 'open' or 'taken'; default 'open' - taken seats are not selectable), 'kind' (string: 'standard', 'extra_legroom', 'exit' or 'premium'; drives the seat colour; default 'standard') and 'price' (number: the seat add-on charge, 0 = included).
- 'currency' (string, optional): ISO currency code for the seat price, e.g. 'USD'. Defaults to USD.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): the select-seat button label; defaults to 'Select seat'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): the base message sent back to the agent when the traveler confirms a seat; the chosen seat id is appended automatically. Defaults to a sensible 'I would like to select this seat' phrase.

Provide every seat you want shown - the map renders exactly the seats in 'seats'. Use these EXACT field names - they are the single contract the card reads.
